The UUV has been identified as the Dive-LD, an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) developed by Anduril. The Dive-LD has a maximum endurance of up to 10 days and is rated to operate at depths of up to 6,000 meters. Its modular design allows it to carry different sensors and payloads for missions including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), mine warfare, seafloor mapping, seabed operations, and precision payload placement. It has more than 1 m³ of payload capacity and can be launched from a pier or various vessels.
